description: Does a trusted, signed evidence note exist for this tree and this check?

actions.name: --help
actions.help: show this help message and exit

actions.name: --lanes-from
actions.help: also hold the check to its lane definition in .st/required-lanes.json at this accepted base: the lane's script blobs must be identical in the verified tree and the base (definition_changed) and the note must carry the base's digest (wrong_definition)

actions.name: --lane-base
actions.help: hold the lane to its definition at this commit (a pull request's branch point, an ancestor of the base with the same lane file) instead of at the base: a tree that only lags main is not a lane edit

actions.name: --require-all
actions.help: judge every check whose policy says `require` (needs --policy-from, --repository and keys); exit 1 only when a check in mode reject is not satisfied, exit 2 (decision error) when it could not decide

actions.name: --project
actions.help: print the input key of the tree for the check's declared paths and exit (needs no keys)

actions.name: --paths
actions.help: with --project: declared paths instead of the policy's

actions.name: --members
actions.help: a per-crate check: satisfied only when every workspace member of the tree has a satisfying note for its own key (needs --policy-from; accepts --lane-base; reads manifests without fetching; the keys come from scripts/rust-test-keys next to this script and .st/rust-test-inputs.json at the base). With --project: print the member keys and stop

actions.name: --crate-key
actions.help: a per-crate check (docs/per-crate-test-signing.md): only records that signed this crate and this input key count, whichever tree they are for (scripts/rust-test-keys prints the keys)

actions.name: --keys
actions.help: allowed-signers file

actions.name: --keys-from
actions.help: read .st/evidence-keys from this commit (the accepted base)

actions.name: --log-keys
actions.help: allowed-signers file of the evidence log key: adds the log's shadow view (refs/evidence-log/main)

actions.name: --log-keys-from
actions.help: read .st/evidence-log-key from this commit (none there: no log view)

actions.name: --command
actions.help: JSON argument vector the record must have run

actions.name: --run-input
actions.help: this run's own value of an input the policy's input_order compares a record's value with (repeatable)

actions.name: --kinds
actions.help: comma-separated record kinds this check accepts (default: nix,wrapper,sekrets,observed)

actions.name: --policy-from
actions.help: apply the skip policy .st/evidence-skip-policy.json read from this accepted base (needs --repository)

actions.name: --repository
actions.help: OWNER/NAME, filled into the skip policy placeholders

actions.name: --max-age
actions.help: reject a record observed longer ago than this, or claiming a future time

actions.name: --runner-prefix
actions.help: the record runner must start with this (e.g. github:org/repo/)

actions.name: --trust-levels
actions.help: comma-separated signer trust levels this check accepts

actions.name: --prefer-levels
actions.help: comma-separated signer levels whose newest passing record decides instead of a newer pass from another level, unless a failing record is dated after it; every other rule still applies

actions.name: --bind-input
actions.help: require the record's input KEY to equal the sha256 of PATH in the verified tree
